title: Possibility of selecting/raising window from the list of windows in the Pager's tooltip
line: Windows listed in the Pager's tooltip can now be clicked to switch to them.
explanation: The pager's desktop tooltip was built as one rich-text string (heading plus a bullet list of window titles), and the tooltip area was not interactive, so it closed as soon as the pointer moved onto it and nothing in it could be clicked. The only way to raise a specific window was to switch desktop first and then find it. The tooltip now uses its own content: the desktop name, then each window (and each minimized window) as a clickable entry with its icon, keeping the existing section labels and the "…and N other windows" overflow. Clicking an entry activates that window through the task model (switching desktop, or unminimizing, as needed) and closes the tooltip.

commits.message:
applets/pager: let windows be raised from the desktop tooltip

Each desktop's tooltip listed its windows as plain text and closed once
the pointer moved onto it. Make it interactive and show every window as
an entry with its icon that activates that window when clicked.

BUG: 368659

media.caption: Master: the desktop tooltip is a plain bulleted list of window titles
Patched: each window is an entry with its icon
Master: moving onto the tooltip closes it, and the click lands on System Settings behind it
Patched: the tooltip stays open, the entry highlights on hover, and clicking it raises Dolphin
